chapter: Depression gigs, Lil Armstrong, joining Chick Webb
title: Months of travel with Chick Webb's band
summary: They toured south to Florida, then back through Cincinnati, Chicago and out west for six months straight.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: before Thanksgiving. We was on the road all that summer.
Our wives would come out and spend a weekend, or something like that, you know.

We gigged. We would go to Baltimore, Washington, Hampton -- on the beach down there, to play the school, you know. We go on down to Atlanta, Charleston, all around. We played all the way down to Florida.
Come back up through Cincinatti, Ohio, then (inaudible) in Chicago for that area, you know. And we'd go on out west again.
Probably come back when we're coming into New York, we'd go back into Detroit or something like that -- Cleveland. Continuous travelling.
